# Musicfy AI
> AI-powered music player. Play, pause, search songs using natural language.

## CONNECT TO CLAUDE
1. Go to: https://claude.ai/settings/connectors
2. Click 'Add custom connector'
3. Paste: https://unmischievously-rheotropic-luca.ngrok-free.dev/mcp
4. Save and open a NEW chat

## HOW IT WORKS
- User tells Claude to play a song
- Claude calls Musicfy MCP tools
- Musicfy website plays the song in real time

## TOOLS
- play_song(song) — Play a song by name on the Musicfy website
- control_playback(action) — pause / resume / stop playback
- search_song(query) — Search for a song

## EXAMPLE USAGE
User: "Play Thuli Thuli"
User: "Pause the music"
User: "Search for AR Rahman songs"

## MCP DETAILS
Endpoint: https://unmischievously-rheotropic-luca.ngrok-free.dev/mcp
